motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: Opacity 0.5 to 1 and translateY 8px to 0; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: choice-hover
motion.purpose: Choice state change; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Path choice
components.css: .ds-choice { cursor:pointer; padding:24px 22px; text-align:left; border:1px solid #504136; background:transparent; color:#f1e8dc; transition:background .2s; } .ds-choice span { font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),sans-serif; font-size:16px; } .ds-choice small { display:block; margin-top:9px; color:#bcb2a6; font-size:13px; line-height:1.6; } .ds-choice:hover,.ds-choice[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#2a2119; } .ds-choice[aria-pressed="true"] { box-shadow:inset 0 -2px #dca063; } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dea367; outline-offset: 5px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-choice { transition:none; } }

components.name: Detail toggle
components.css: .ds-detail { cursor:pointer; background:transparent; border:0; color:#e0a770; min-height:44px; font-size:15px; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:5px; } .ds-detail:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dea367; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Typing input
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-typing">Type: steady lah, one step at a time</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-typing" placeholder="Start typing here…">
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:10px; color:#d0c4b5; } .ds-input { width:100%; padding:14px; min-height:48px; border:1px solid #7f6b57; border-radius:4px; background:#15120f; color:#f4eadc; font-size:16px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#b9aa99; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity:.75; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dea367; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Artifact panel
components.html: Route Archiver · illustrative example
components.css: .ds-artifact { background:#211c17; border:1px solid #4b3b2e; border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-artifact p { padding:22px 24px; font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),sans-serif; font-size:12px; color:#d2b99e; } .ds-artifact button { cursor:pointer; width:100%; padding:18px 24px; background:transparent; color:#e0a770; border:0; border-top:1px solid #4b3b2e; font-size:14px; } .ds-artifact button:hover { background:#32281e; } .ds-artifact button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dea367; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Tour navigation
components.css: .ds-tour { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:16px; border-top:1px solid #40362d; padding-top:16px; } .ds-tour button { cursor:pointer; background:transparent; border:0; min-height:44px; color:#e0a770; font-size:15px; } .ds-tour button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dea367; outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview: The existing dark copper photographic identity carries into a guided, conversational homepage. Warm charcoal, copper accents, generous display type and restrained framed artifacts keep software demonstrations and photography in the same visual family.
dos: Do retain the dark copper palette and photographic identity.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, readable labels and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't treat legacy pink and blue theme declarations as the homepage palette.
Don't promote the guided homepage composition into a rule for every page.
